The '''mother''' of the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and her brother, [[Ayx]], was, along with [[Javul Charn's father|her partner]], a [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who toured the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The pair used their tours to run information between resistance cells. Both she and her partner were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an Imperial raid while performing at a venue on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].
